planets.name: TOI-1774 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1774 with a 16.7-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1774 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1774. Its orbit and size follow Lienhard et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
